Visitor replaces line break with custom output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_line_break(self, ctx, *args):  # noqa: A002, ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": " | "}
    html = "<p>First line<br>Second line<br>Third line</p>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
